envelopes.purpose: Productive first familiarization without perfect product history
envelopes.essentialStimulus: Comfortable aerobic participation and controlled practice of demonstrated movement patterns
admissibleStructures: Walk/jog entry using walk exposure and conversational effort; walking is a valid alternative when running not yet tolerated
Unloaded demonstrated sit-to-stand/supported movement practice; do not assign an unknown external load
Initial week must specify every proposed task and fit all chosen windows; no full-week success for a partial subtask
progressionOptions: After observed compatible execution/effort/next-day function, consider one smallest meaningful dimension
regressionOptions: Walk rather than jog; fewer practice repetitions; stop on abnormal response
substitutionOptions: Only available competent movement patterns; unfamiliar loaded task requires establishment
schedulingConstraints: Respect actual minutes, days, equipment and priority; never silently replace existing essential run work
otherModalityInteraction: Retain familiar primary work; new secondary skill practice carries low demand

envelopes.purpose: Reuse/compose personally calibrated run work and earn one-dimensional progression
envelopes.essentialStimulus: Requested easy, steady, long or controlled cruise stimulus using personal effort/exposure
admissibleStructures: Familiar easy/steady full session with pace subordinate to current effort
Cruise repetitions at familiar controlled-hard cue with easy self-paced preparation/cooldown
Relaxed familiar strides only with independently approved session completion; never all-out extrapolation
progressionOptions: Choose a supplied previously tolerated next dose when comparable responses and future week support it
Keep intensity stable while changing duration/reps; no universal ten-percent rule
regressionOptions: Retain prior dose; reduce work when effort diverges; terminate hard work if response incompatible
substitutionOptions: Walking/easy exit for incompatible response, not a falsely equivalent threshold dose
schedulingConstraints: Duration includes preparation/recovery/cooldown; protect future essential work and available window
otherModalityInteraction: No simultaneous unreviewed strength escalation; key stimulus and priority used before progression
boundaries: No VO2 pace from proprietary prediction
No race pace from old/downhill/noncomparable result
No hill prescription from flat pace
Threshold is intent, not measured LT2/CS equivalence
Preparation/cooldown are new coaching choices, never fabricated historical tolerance
